name: Demo OGC API processes instance - LOF
abstract: An example of an OGC API Processes implementation using building blocks - Local Outlier Factor
description: This OGC API Process served as an example implementation in the LDV (Logboek Dataverwerkingen voor (geo) objecten) project. It uses a Local Outlier Factor Machine Learning Algorithm for classification of observations/measurements. The Process itself does not expose provenance information directly in the API, but in the implementation OpenTelemetry is used server side to create a trace with provenance information using the OpenTelemetry Trace/Span semantics and adhering to the Dutch LDV standard.
